title: ‘Remembering Dolly: A Rhinestone Life’: Here’s Where to Watch the Dolly Parton Tribute TV Special Online Free
summary: The special pays tribute to Parton's life and music legacy — it broadcasts coast-to-coast on Aug. 30.
contentText:

After her death at age 80 on Aug. 25, there have been a number of tributes for Dolly Parton . And now, there’s a new TV special titled Remembering Dolly: A Rhinestone Life that celebrates the musical and cultural impact of the Grammy winner over the last six decades.

Co-hosted by Kevin Frazier and Nischelle Turner of Entertainment Tonight , the TV special pays tribute to Parton’s life and music legacy with a series of interviews with her throughout her career. It also features tributes from recording artists, such as Dionne Warwick, Melissa Etheridge, Diane Warren, Debbie Allen, Jennifer Nettles and others. It airs on Sunday (Aug. 30).

How to Watch ‘Remembering Dolly: A Rhinestone Life’ Online, At a Glance:

- Date: Sunday, Aug. 30

- Start time: 8 p.m. ET/PT

- TV channel: CBS

- Livestream: Paramount+ , DirecTV , Fubo , Hulu + Live TV

Watch with DirecTV

When Does ‘Remembering Dolly: A Rhinestone Life’ Start ?

The TV special Remembering Dolly: A Rhinestone Life broadcasts on CBS , with an airtime of 8 p.m. ET/PT. It also streams on Paramount+.

Where to Watch ‘Remembering Dolly: A Rhinestone Life’ Online for Free

For cord-cutters, there are a few ways to watch Remembering Dolly: A Rhinestone Life , especially if you want to watch for free. DirecTV has a five-day free trial , while other streaming services, such as Fubo and Hulu + Live TV , offer a free trial so you can watch CBS for free.

Get Paramount+
